In the nude mice bearing human ovarian cancer, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">153</sup>Sm-H-OV-5 ScFv has affinity to the over-expressed ovarian cancer single chain antibody H-OV-5. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">153</sup>Sm-H-OV-5 ScFv is promising to become the direct carrier of ovarian cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: The effect of aerobic exercise on atheromatous plaques area and inflammatory-ralated serum cytokines of apoE-deficient mice
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: In this study, ApoE-deficient mice was used as atherosclerosis(AS) model to approach the effect and mechanism of aerobic exercise on formation of atherosclerotic lesions and serum inflammatory-related cytokines. 20 ApoE-deficient mice were randomly divided into sedentary control group (SCG) and exercise group (EG, swimming, 90 min/d, 6 d/w, 10 wks), the lesion area and serum lipid and serum inflammatory-related cytokines were tested after 10 weeks. Compared with SCG, the lesion area in the aorta and the serum lipid of EG were improved significantly P<;0.05). The serum levels of TNF-α and IL-6 of EG were significantly down-regulated (P<;0.01), and the adiponectin level of EG was up-related(P<;0.01). The results suggested that aerobic exercise significantly improved the condition of apoE-deficient mice and simultaneously improved the fat metabolism. Aerobic exercise significantly decreased the pro-inflammatory cytokine and increased the anti-inflammatory cytokine simultaneously in apoE-deficient mice.

articleTitle: Comparative study of MSCTA with DSA in the blood supply of meningiomas
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Evaluation of multi-slice CT angiography (MSCTA) and digital subtraction angiography (DSA) was made through the comparison of the two methods in the detection of the blood supply of meningiomas, providing further clues for improved application of MSCTA and DSA in the blood supply of meningiomas. MSCTA is more advantageous in the depiction of three-dimensional relationships between the tumor and peripheral vessels and skull. And, compared to DSA, MSCTA is noninvasive, faster and cheaper.

articleTitle: An analytic survey of the physical rehabilitation's effect upon the bronchi asthma senior sufferers
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The aim of this research is to study the physical rehabilitation's function and also its effect upon the seniors who are suffering from bronchi asthma. 57 bronchi asthma senior sufferers are divided at random into two groups: the experiment group (a year's physical rehabilitation exercise) and the contrast group (no physical rehabilitation exercise, but sharing the other things with the experiment). After a year's experiment, this research shows that there is a big difference between the two groups and there is also a big difference before and after they took the experiment-the physical rehabilitation exercise did help to improve the asthma senior sufferers' heart and lungs function, to raise the anti-disease ability, and to relieve the symptom of the occurring-a distinguished curative effect.

articleTitle: A grey relational analysis on the performances of the World Best Men's Decathletes
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The study was to find the grey correlation between the performances and 10 disciplines of men's decathletes with the help of the grey relational analysis. Data in the form of scores for 192 performances in the decathlon over 8500 points was collected and then subjected to grey relational analysis. The results indicate the 10 disciplines, can be classified into five factor sets, which the Percent Contributions of five factor sets to the performance are 30.58%, 20.12%, 19.92%, 19.67%, and 9.72% respectively. By comparing the results between the different studies, it was found the decathletes who succeed in decathlon should be all-round development in all the biomotor abilities, as well as to produce technical improvements in all 10 disciplines.

articleTitle: Periodic solutions of discrete time and ratio-dependent system with one predator and two cooperative preys
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we consider a three-species ratio-dependent predator-prey model governed by difference equations with periodic coefficients and discrete time, in which two cooperative preys are preyed by one predator. By using the method of coincidence degree, we discuss the existence of positive periodic solutions of this system; a set of easily verifiable sufficient conditions is obtained.

articleTitle: Cohort study on hypertension prevalence in certain rural area of Jilin province
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Analysis and investigation on hypertension prevalence and changing trend among some rural population in Jilin province to determine the major risk factors and provide scientific data for hypertension preventive effort in Jilin province. By stratified cluster sampling and cohort study, the major risk factors surveying and blood pressure testing were carried out on 721 regular residents aged from 45 to 74 year old in Yongji County, Jilin Province during a 7 year period from 2000 to 2007. Data gathered was statistically analyzed. Results: During the 7 years, hypertension prevalence increased 15.3% (37.17% in 2000, 52.47% in 2007, p<;0.01). And increase on moderate and server Hypertension was more remarkable (15.81% in 2000, 24.86% in 2007, p<;0.01). Increasing trend in hypertension prevalence was observed in the population. Hypertension prevalence among rural population in Jilin province was higher than that of the rest of our country. And the trend was on the rise. Therefore, proactively spreading the knowledge regarding hypertension and health care to rural people and taking various effective ways to strengthen primary and secondary prevention for hypertension shall be in high priority in our province.

articleTitle: Characterization of maternal plasma miRNAs expression profile by SOLiD sequencing
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: It is reported that circulating miRNAs are potential new biomarkers for diagnostic and other clinical applications. To study the varieties of plasma miRNAs expression, we investigated maternal plasma miRNAs expression profiles using SOLiD sequencing technology. The results showed that the distribution and abundance of specific miRNAs in plasma are varying during physiological pregnancy process. We chose 11 abundant maternal plasma miRNAs(let-7a, let-7b, miR-192, 22, 24, 25, 26a, 29a, 375, 451, 320a), then analyzed their functions by literature review. The results showed that specific miRNA associated with regulation of some physiologic processes, such as inflammation, muscle differentiation, insulin resistance. These processes may play important roles in normal pregnancy process. This study also proved that SOLiD sequencing technology was an effective method for plasma miRNAs expression profiling.

articleTitle: Analysis of fine individual no-cones platanus acerifoliaby ISSR molecular marker
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Germination of platanus acerifolia's winter buds and cones falling bring great inconvenience to people's lives, therefore, how to reduce it becomes an issue of concern. Now studies on platanus acerifolia are mostly from phenotypic variation and follow-up observations which had difficulty in guaranteeing long-term stability, but less at the molecular level. This experiment use young leaves of fine individual none-or-little cones platanus acerifolia as experimental materials, adopt suitable CTAB method to extract DNA, then sixty-five ISSR primer were screened by two different samples, eleven high-definition, repeatability and strong stability ISSR primer combinations were chose for the ISSR analysis of the fourteen platanus acerifolia materials. Do Cluster Analysis with NTSYS software, constructing system trees. The results show that the genetic similar coefficients (GSC) were 0.58–0.77, and 14 materials were divided into 5 groups at GSC 0.67 based on the cluster analysis of UPGMA method.

articleTitle: Anti-tumor effect of BCGHSP70-B16TCL in subcutaneous tumor-bearing mice
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: In this study, BCGHSP70-B16TCL was prepared by directly mixing the BCG derived heat shock protein 70(BCGHSP70) with tumor cell lysate of B16 melanoma cells (B16TCL) in vitro and then administered to the subcutaneous B16 melanoma-bearing mice in the prophylactic immunization strategy to observe its anti-tumor effects. Data showed that prophylactic immunization with BCGHSP70-B16TCL could significantly prolong the tumor latency and inhibit the B16 melanoma growth in the early stage and prolong the lifespan of subcutaneous B16 melanoma-bearing mice. These results suggested that BCGHSP70-B16TCL might be administrated to induce potent anti-tumor effect for tumor prevention and treatment, particularly be given in postoperative cancer patients using the prophylactic strategy.

articleTitle: Cloning of HSA-GHGKHKNK fusion protein cDNA and its experssion in Pichia pastoris
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: GHGKHKNK octapeptide has tumoricidal potential mainly due to the amino acid residues of His-Gly-Lys motif inhibits the clone formation, adhesion and invasion of tumor cells. However, its clinical application is limited by its short half-life time in vivo. We used human serum albumin (HSA) fusion technology to fuse GHGKHKNK octapeptide and HSA to prolong half-life time of GHGKHKNK octapeptide and increase its stability. the GHGKHKNK - HSA fusion protein gene was cloned into the secretor type expression vector pPICZaC and subsequently expressed in Pichia pastoris. The supernatant fusion protein was detected by SDS-PAGE and purified with Blue Sepharose 6 Fast Flow chromatography. The clone formation rate of melanoma B16-F10 cell strain and the effect of the octapetide on the expression level of LN-R, ICAM-1 in melanoma B16-F10 cell strain were measured. Results suggested that infusion reaction between GHGKHKNK octapeptide and HSA did not destroy biologic activity of GHGKHKNK octapeptide.

articleTitle: Role of losartan and MAPK pathway in the natriuresis induced by central stimul
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: This study investigated the effect of intracerebroventricular (ICV) administration of the angiotensin AT<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> receptor antagonist losartan on the natriuresis, pressor effect, and the mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPK) activity in the rostroventrolateral medulla (RVLM) caused by ICV injection of either angiotensin II (ANG II) or carbachol. Losartan (20μg) was infused into the lateral ventricle before, during, and after infusions of either ANG II at 10 μg, or carbachol at 0.5 μg. ICV injection of ANG II or carbachol caused increases in urinary sodium excretion, arterial pressure, and the activity of MAPK in the RVLM. Increases in arterial pressure, Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> excretion, and the activity of MAPK in the RVLM in response to ICV injection of ANG II were either abolished or attenuated by ICV injection of losartan. ICV injection of losartan did not reduce the increase in arterial pressure in response to ICV injection of carbachol, but it did attenuate the natriuretic response to ICV administration of carbachol. We conclude that an ICV dose of losartan that inhibits responses to ICV injection of ANG II also inhibits natriuresis, and the pressor response to ICV injection of carbachol. These results suggest that common neural pathways are involved in the responses induced by ICV administration of ANG II and carbachol. We propose that ICV injection of carbachol activates angiotensinergic and MAPK signal pathways in the central nervous system subserving the regulation of fluid and electrolyte balance and arterial pressure in rat.

articleTitle: MRI observation and pathological correlation study of rat C6 brain glioma
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: SD rat C6 brain glioma model is established, and observe its pathological characteristic and MRI. C6 glioma cells were implanted through stereotactic orientator, and C6 brain glioma rat model was established. The change of tumor body growth (MRI) at Week 1, 2 and 3 after the implantation was observed, and compared with gross pathological results. The intracranial implantation via stereotactic orientation had a success rate of 100%, and there was no distal and extracranial metastasis. As shown by T2WI and enhanced T1WI scanning, tumor body grew with peritumor edema at the end of Week 1 after the implantation, and grew rapidly to a volume approximate to gross pathological results two weeks later. It had a high success rate to establish rat C6 brain glioma model through stereotactic orientation. MRI + pathological examination could better reflect the growth way and development process of tumor.

articleTitle: Psychological intervention treatment in psychiatric rehabilitation
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The psychological intervention treatment is a necessary treatment to achieve the healthy return to the society in psychiatric rehabilitation. It is the core of modern bio - psycho - social medical model. The psychological intervention treatment in psychiatric rehabilitation is implemented on several aspects of cognitive model reformation, emotional regulation training, life skills training for social interaction, family psychology intervention treatment and so on.

articleTitle: The related study of whitening efficacy of ginseng extract-ginsenoside Rb1
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Objective: The effect of ginsenoside Rb1 on in vitro mushroom tyrosinase and the proliferation of B16 melanocyte were studied. Method: The detection of in vitro activity of mushroom tyrosinase; The determination of cell proliferation rate. Result: The inhibition rate of Rb1 samples at different concentrations to in vitro mushroom tyrosinase is obviously lower than arbutin with an inhibition rate between ±0.05. The effect of ginsenoside Rb1 on the proliferation of B16 melanocyte is changed along with the changes of concentration. Conclusion: There is no obviously effect of ginsenoside Rb1 on in vitro activity of mushroom tyrosinase. When the concentration is lower than 125 μg/ml, the proliferation of B16 melanocyte is promoted. But the proliferation of B16 melanocyte is depressed with the concentration of ginsenoside Rb1 above 125 μg/ml.

articleTitle: cDNA cloning and prokaryotic expression of mouse 14–3–3 protein theta
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To clone the cDNA of mouse 14-3-3θ protein gene, investigate its prokaryotic expression and produce purified recombinant mouse 14-3-3θ protein. The recombinant plasmid containing mouse 14-3-3θ gene was transformed into E. Coli BL21 to express a fusion protein with mouse 14-3-3θ protein tagged by glutathione-S-transferase (GST). The fusion protein was then cleaved by thrombin during passing through the GST-agarose 4B column to release the recombinant mouse 14-3-3θ protein. DNA sequencing confirmed that the cloned cDNA contained 738 base pairs encoding 254 amino acids, which was identical to the reported amino acid sequence of mouse 14-3-3θ. After transformation, the recombinant plasmid pGEX-14-3-3θ expressed a soluble protein that was inducible by IPTG. The purified recombinant protein was shown to be single band on SDS-PAGE, with a molecular size of around 30kDa, which was identical to the reported molecular size of mouse 14-3-3θ. Western blot analysis demonstrated that the recombinant protein was recognized by specific antibody against 14-3-3θ.

articleTitle: The effects of tissue factor in the hematogenous metastasis of fibrosarcoma cells
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To evaluate the effects of tissue factor in the hematogenous metastasis of fibrosarcoma cells, the expression of tissue factor in the fibrosarcoma cell was detected by flow cytometry. The intravascular migration and extravascular migration of tumor cells were evaluate by the migration models. It was confirmed by flow cytometry that tissue factor had high expression in fibrosarcoma cells. The fibrosarcoma cell migrated through the collagen gel and the monolayer vascular endothelial cell from different direction, just like the intravascular migration and extravascular migration. The antibody of tissue factor could inhibit this migration process and the inhibition had concentration dependent. It was confirmed that tissue factor could promote the intravascular migration and extravascular migrationthe of fibrosarcoma cell and promote the hematogenous metastasis.

articleTitle: Effect of ultrasound in combination with food additives on polyphenol oxidase activity
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Polyphenol oxidase was treated with ascorbic acid, citric acid, sodium sulfite, potassium sorbate in combination with ultrasound. The effect of these treatments on the activity of PPO was studied. Results indicated that the separate treatment of ascorbic acid, citric acid, sodium sulfite could obviously inhibit PPO activity and could make a completely inhibition when the concentration was respectively 1 mM, 1 mM and 10 mM. Ascorbic acid or citric acid in combination with ultrasound had a certain synergistic effect for PPO inactivation. Whether treated alone or combined with ultrasound, potassium sorbate would promote PPO activity when the concentration was less than 2000 mM.

articleTitle: The effect of chloride channel inhibitor NPPB on proliferation and apoptosis of human trabecular meshwork cells
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Objective To study the effect of chloride channel inhibitor NPPB(5-nitro-2-(3-phenyl-propylamino)-benzoic acid) on proliferation, cell cycle and apoptosis of human trabecular meshwork cells. Method Using MTT, flow cytometry, Annexin V-PI and mitochondrial membrane potential, we explored the role of NPPB with different centration (10μM, 50μM, 100μM) in cell proliferation, cell cycle, apoptosis and mitochondrial membrane potential of TMC respectively. Rsults NPPB inhibited proliferation of TMC in a concentration-dependent manner. The proliferation of TMC was inhibited 55.6% by 100μM NPPB, and there was significant difference, P<; 0.01. Cell population increased in G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>/G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> phase, while decreased in S phase induced by NPPB. NPPB was able to increase the apoptosis induced by 5-FU and reduce the mitochondrial membrane potential in TMC at the time point of 24h and 48h. Conclusion Chloride channel positively correlated with proliferation of TMC and promoted TMC into S phase via G1/S check point. In addition, ClC might be involved in anti-apoptosis mechanism through interfering internal mitochondrial pathway.

articleTitle: Myocardial protective effect of 3-aminobenzamide through inhibition of poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase activation in diabetic rats
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To investigate myocardial protective effect of 3-aminobenzamide (3-AB) in STZ-induced diabetic rats and its mechanism. In the 12th weekend plasma glucose, heart function, the levels of myocardial 8-OHdG and 3-NT and the expression changes of PARP1 at the protein level are detected. The study shows that after 12 weeks of STZ treatment the plasma glucose concentration, 8-OHdG and 3-NT level and the protein expression of PARP1 of diabetic rats were significantly (P<;0.01) higher than the control group. Diabetic rats treated with STZ for 12 weeks show a significant cardiac dysfunction. Compared with the diabetes model group, blood glucose and 3-NT levels decreased, cardiac function improved and PARP1 protein downregulated (P<;0.01) in the diabetic rats of 3-AB treatment. PARP inhibitor 3-AB can protect myocardium through reducing blood glucose and the stress response of nitrification to some extent, downregulating PARP1 expression and improving heart function in diabetic rats.

articleTitle: Isolation, purification and structural characterization of polysaccharide POP I b from portulace oleracea L
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: In order to study the composition and structural characterization of poly saccharide POP I b from portulace oleracea L., the polysaccharides were extracted by boiling water and precipitated by 95% ethanol firstly. After being removed protein by Sevage reagent, the refined POP I b was isolated and purified by DEAE-cellulose column and Sephadex G-200 column. Its homogeneity was proved by cellulose acetate film electrophoresis and Sephadex G-200 column. And its compositions and structures were measured and analyzed preliminarily by thin layer chromatography (TLC), GC, IR and NMR. The results showed that POP I b is homogeneous and it is made up of arabinose, galactose and galacturonic acid. The mole ratio of arabinose and galactose is 1:1.72, meanwhile, there are characteristic absorption bands of polysaccharide and β-(1→4) glycoside linkages in its structure. POP lb is considered as a kind of heteropolysaccharide with complex structure containing much arabinose, galactose and galacturonic acid, and is obtained for the first time from portulace oleracea L.

articleTitle: Diffuse brainstem hypertensive encephalopathy in a patient with renal failure: A case report
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Predominant diffuse brainstem hypertensive encephalopathy is rare, especially in a patient with renal failure. Despite the severity of the neuroradiological findings, the clinical manifestations are mild. The radiological abnormalities resolved after blood pressure controlled. We report a patient with transient diffuse brainstem lesions on MRI. He had hypertension and renal failure. His neurological symptoms were disproportionately mild compared with the MRI features, which were of diffuse hyperintensities in the brainstem on T2-weighted and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) images. There were no accompanying changes in the parieto-occipital lobe. We consider that extremely high blood pressure may provoke diffuse brainstem lesions. Renal failure may aggravate this damage.

articleTitle: Stroke rehabilitation treatment: Evaluation of combined application of SGT-700 apparatus and fluoxetine
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: A combined therapy of early rehabilitation, SGT-700 apparatus and fluoxetine was used for the treatment of stroke in this study. 206 Cases of patients with stroke were selected based on the diagnostic standard. ADL of patients was evaluated with Barthel index (BI) and the nervous functional deficiency of the patients was evaluated with SSS. There were no significant differences in ADL and SSS scores among group A, B, C and D before the treatment. The scores of patients after the treatment in the different groups were compared with those before the treatment in them and the differences were significant. The comparison in ADL and SSS scores between group B and Group A, and the comparison in ADL and SSS scores between group C and group B were significantly different. The comparison in ADL and SSS scores between group D and group C was significantly different. The results suggests that the combined application of fluoxetine and the therapeutic apparatus can produce a satisfactory curative effect on patients with stroke, and improve the patients' nervous functional deficiency and the ability of daily life.

articleTitle: Clinical application of modified incision and sternocleidomastoid muscle flap in surgery of parotid gland tumors
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To discuss the clinical value of modified incision and at the same time sternocleidomastoid muscle flap transfer to repair defect in the parotid gland surgery. 66 cases of parotid gland benign tumor were randomly divided into two groups, A group and B group. Patients of A group were used modified incision and at the same time sternocleidomastoid muscle flap Transfer. Patients of B group were used the traditional "S"-shaped incision and no at the same time sternocleidomastoid muscle flap transferred. Follow-up observation of facial deformities, wound healing, Frey's syndrome, salivary fistula and sternocleidomastoid muscle dysfunction, and so on. Results: The postoperative follow-up of 12 months, sternocleidomastoid muscle dysfunction was no significant difference between A group and B group. A group was significantly better than the B group in remaining aspects. Adopting modified incision and at the same time sternocleidomastoid muscle flap transfer to repair defect in the Parotid gland surgery. The postoperative wound was very Hidden and face was beautiful. Meanwhile the incidence of the Frey's syndrome and salivary fistula were reduced.

articleTitle: Research on the function of human embryo chorion promoting proliferation of cord blood CD34+ cells
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: In many researches hematopoietic growth factors are used to stimulate the proliferation of cord blood CD34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> cells. But the proliferation quantity is not ideal enough, the cells are easily differentiated downwards. In this research human embryo chorion(HEC) is used as the culture medium for the observation of its functions in the proliferation of cord blood CD34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> cells. We isolated CD34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> cells from cord blood and cultured it using HEC as the culture medium to measure the quantity, purity and colony forming of CD34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> cells. It shows the 3 indexes of HEC group are all significantly higher than those of HGF group. These data implies HEC has the function of promoting the proliferation of cord blood CD34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> cells. Thus, this research effectively solves the problem of the shortage in cord blood CD34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> cells prior to the transplantation, which enables the wide application of cord blood CD34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> cells transplantation in adults.

articleTitle: Yangxin Soup's treatment progress of heart diseases
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Yangxin Soup's application and advances in the clinical treatment of heart diseases currently. Method: conclude and summarize application experiences of different schools in Yangxin Soup by inquiring journals and databases. Results: Yangxin Soup can be applied to treat various of heart diseases. Conclusion: Yangxin Soup is effective on treatment of heart diseases.

articleTitle: Effect of polimixin B and neomycin sulfate on growth of selected probiotics
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Effect of polimixin B and neomycin sulfate on growth of Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium bifidum, Lactobacillus bulgaricus, Lactobacillus rhamnosus and Lactobacillus casei was studied by measuring the optical density at 600nm and pH using De Man, Rogosa and Sharpe (MRS) broth as the control. The addition of polimixin B was 33.3U, 66.6U, 100U and 133.3U and the addition of nalidixic acid (%, w/v) was 0.0005, 0.003, 0.006 and 0.010. Results were as follows: addition of polimixin B at the concentration above 33.3U has a significant inhibition on the growth of B. bifidum and has no influence on the other four probiotics at incubation 24h. The optimum selective concentration of polimixin B in MRS media was 33.3U for selective enumeration of B. bifidum. Addition of neomycin sulfate has a significant inhibition on the growth of the five selected probiotics at incubation 24h. Addition of neomycin sulfate in MRS can not use to realize selective enumeration in yogurt containing probiotics.

articleTitle: Study on tissue compatibility and genotoxicity of a radiation sterilized disposable burette transfusion apparatus
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The aim of the study was to evaluate the effect of radiation sterilization on biocompatibility of a disposable burette transfusion apparatus, in order to assess the safety of radiation sterilized medical devices. The initial bacteria burden of the burette transfusion apparatus was examed according to the ISO11737 standard, we combined cytotoxicity test, sensitization test and dermal irritation test to evaluate the tissue compatibility of the radiation sterilized samples, and the genotoxicity was investigated with chromosomal aberration test and micronucleus test. The study determined the verified sterilizing dosage at the level of 9.4kGy, results show the sample products had no cytotoxicity, no sensitization, no intracutaneous irritation, no genotoxicity in chromosome aberration test, and will not increase the micronucleus rate of PCE (p<;0.05). Disposable burette transfusion apparatus showed good tissue compatibility and had no genotoxicity after radiation sterilization. Radiation sterilization is a biologically safe method for sterilization of medical devices.

articleTitle: Value of the relationship with plasma NT-proBNP and heart function in diagnosis of cardiac insufficiency
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Objective to investigate the plasma NT-proBNP in value in early diagnosis of aged patients with diastolic heart failure. 26 cases of cardiac function in normal checkup for the control group, a clear diagnosis in patients with systolic heart failure (LVEF<;50%) Group of 25 cases, normal heart diastolic heart failure (LVEF ≥ 50%, E/A ≤ 1) 32 cases and heart expanding group of 38 cases of diastolic heart failure. ELISA method for the determination of plasma NT-proBNP concentration. Results 1. NYHA functional class associated with the NT-proBNP concentration is notable is a line (r=0.658, P<;0.01), LVEF associated with NT-proBNP concentration is significantly negative linear (r=-0.608, P<;0.01), NT-proBNP statistically significant difference between the NYHA classification (P<;0.01). 2. the Group of plasma NT-proBNP level in heart failure with significant statistical differences between the various groups (P<;0.01). Plasma NT-proBNP conclusions can do for objective indicators for evaluating severity of heart failure; Especially for early diagnosis of diastolic heart failure.

articleTitle: Effects of organic acid in Folium Isatidis on the immune organ index and activity of enzymes involved in free radicals of immunosuppressed mice
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effects of organic acid in Folium Isatidis (OAFI) on the antioxidant capacity of immunosuppressed mice. The immunosuppression model was established by administering dexamethasone (Dex) 1.25 mg·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, in vivo by subcutaneous injection. The thymus and spleen indices, MDA and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> levels, and the activities of 4 enzymes that are related to free radical production and scavenging were measured after the mice were treated with 250 mg kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> OAFI by gavage. OAFI significantly increased the spleen index of immunosuppressed mice, and it also decreased MDA and increased T-SOD, T-AOC, POD, and XOD levels of immunosuppressed mice. These results suggest OAFI can affect the production and elimination of free radicals by changing the activity of related enzymes, increasing the spleen index and decreasing MDA levels of peroxidation products. This would accordingly protect the immunological organs, so that they can resist the immunosuppression caused by Dex and strengthen immunity to diseases.

articleTitle: Experimental research into the influence on middle school students' mental health during health promotion
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: It is pointed by the mental hygiene office of WHO: schools are the optimum places for promoting students' mental health as they may impart some skills for solving problems to students and change students' behaviors by intervening in special problems and giving psychological consultation. The Physical Education and Health has become one part of school education, which is the main way for promoting students' health and is naturally tasked to help students to improve their endurance and anti-frustration ability. The research is based on the experiments to promote middle school students' mental health, aiming at establishing a model for promoting middle school students' mental health through the experimental research into the promotion of middle school students' mental health, providing theoretical support for training new qualified talents as required for the society and making contributions to social harmony.

articleTitle: Protective effects of puerarin solution on alcohol encephalopathy hippocampus
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To examine the effects of Puerarin solution on alcohol-induced injuries in hippocampus. Thirty Wistar rats were divided into control group, model group and puerarin group. After 30 days, the Endotoxin (ET) levels in plasma and TNF-α in cerebral tissue were measured. Pathological changes in cerebral tissue were observed by light microscope. ET and TNF-α in the model group were significantly higher than those in the control group (p<;0.05); ET and TNF-α in puerarin group was slightly higher than those in the control group and significantly lower than those in the model group (p<;0.01); Mild pathological changes in hippocampus of model group, no obvious pathological changes in the other groups. The protective effects of puerarin may be related to its inhibition of ET and TNF-α production.

articleTitle: Surveys and analysis on mid-and-low income groups' medical services demand of Jilin City
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The aim of this paper is to investigate the current situation of mid-and-low income households' medical demand in Jilin City and find some problems between medical demands and medical service. Finally, proposes some specific strategies to these problems in order to improve our country's medical health reform system. The data getting from questionnaires which are distributed to 315 mid and low income households of Jilin City with the help of software SPSS13 are analyzed. High medical expense is a heave burden among the mid-and-low income households; basic medical insurance for urban residents has poor effectiveness; the residents lack of the understanding of medical insurance; the function of community medical service organization is not fully displayed. Our suggestions include fulfilling government duties, strengthening publicity, enhancing community health service, and implementing residents' medical cares are some effective ways to improve medical demands of our country's mid-and-low income households.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis on nursing disputes and the family of patients
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Through the attribution analysis of various factors of the patient's family, the article probes into issues related to nursing dispute and the patient's family so as to adopt different interventions to different individuals and improve the management of hospital care. Analysis of dying traj ectory's effect on family psychology, family education level, economic status, geographical and other factors. Dying traj ectory, family economic status and other factors are related to the psychological needs and reactions of the patient's family. Only through diversified analyzing psychological reaction of the patient's family, we can adopt a variety of interventions for each individual.

articleTitle: Empirical study of the effects of Guided Yangshenggong for the health status and quality of life in the middle-old aged peoples
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To reveal the effects of long-term Guided Yangshenggong exercise on health status and quality of life in middle-old aged peoples. The article used Comparison with experimental method, SF-36 scale test, interview and mathematical statistics and studied the compare of the health status and quality of life between often practice Guided Yangshenggong and not often practice Guided Yangshenggong' middle-old aged people. After a year of Guided Yangshenggong practice, the experimental group in the Physical functioning(PF), Role limitations due to physical health (RP), Vitality (VT), Social functioning(SF), Physical component summary(PCS) and Mental component summary(MCS) compared with the control group was significant difference (P <0.05); The role limitations due to emotional problems(RE) and Mental health (MH) were instability during the experiment. Frequently engage Guided Yangshenggong exercise can significantly improve the health status and quality of life for the middle-old aged people.

articleTitle: Characterization and identification of cytochrome b DNA fingerprinting between the penis et testis of the Cervus nippon Temmink and the bullwhip
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The characteristics of cytochrome b gene (Cytb) features in the mitochondrial DNA (mt DNA) from the Penis et Testis of the Cervus nippon Temmink were explored, and a specific method was set up to identify the Penis et Testis of the Cervus nippon Temmink from the bullwhip. The mtDNA were extracted from the Penis et Testis of the Cervus nippon Temmink. A pair of allele-specific primers were designed by the primer design software. The fragment with 306 bp was amplified by PCR from the Penis et Testis of the Cervus nippon Temmink, not from the bullwhip. The Cytb DNA fingerprinting of the Cervus nippon Temmink showed the specificity for identification from the Penis et Testis of the Cervus nippon Temmink and the bullwhip. The method could be used to differentiate the authentic deer-whip from goods sold on the markets.

Author Keywords: Penis et Testis of Cervus nippon Temmink

articleTitle: Old model of health promotion campaign
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: With the development of society and the improvement of living standard, people have a longer and longer life span, however, at the same time due to the emergence of a series of "civilized disease", there is a increasingly decrease on old people's physical and functional level. The increasingly trend of aging population has become a serious social issue. It is imperative that something should be done to improve the living quality and healthy level of old people.

articleTitle: Development in the research of exercise and visfatin
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Visfatin was a new adenosine, expressed highly in adipose tissue of viscous organs of person and mouse, the level of visfatin in plasma usually increased as the fat degree rising. visfatin had the effect as insulin to capitulate the glucose level and mend insulin resistant. research had found that visfatin had important relation to metabolism syndrome and some disease correlation to metabolism such as diabetes and fatness and arteriosclerosis. exercise should reduce the visfatin level in plasma and rise the visfatin mRNA express in adipose tissue. visfatin perhaps was a kind of signal molecule of exercise improve metabolize status and prevention some disease correlation to metabolism.

articleTitle: The anticoagulant activity of polysaccharide and sulfate from corn-cob
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Extracted the polysaccharide and sulfate from corn-cob, and approached the anticoagulant activity of them in vivo and in vitro in this study. Methods Water-soluble crude polysaccharide has been extracted by acid from corn-cod. Sulfation of ACC with chlorosulfonic acid-pyridine, and detection of sulfate content by Ion Chromatography; Determination the bleeding time(BT) and clotting time(CT) of small white mice. Result the Corn-cob polysaccharide extraction was 12.5g; Sulfated polysa-ccharide Sulfate was 9.86%; the BT and CT were prolonged in vivo with statistic significant difference (p<;0.01) except low-dose and mid-dose group were show Little effect (p>;0.05) Conclusion The anticoagulation effect of high-dose group ACC, ACP and ACS were showed in vivo and dose-dependent relation.

articleTitle: VEGF-C, VEGF-D, and VEGFR-3 and their roles in lymphatic metastasis of tumors
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Lymphatic metastasis is one of the critical metastatic routes of malignant tumors, and the involvement of lymph nodes is usually one of the key predictors of prognosis. In recent years, studies on animal models and clinical studies have suggested that vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF)-C/VEGF-D/VEGF receptor-3 (VEGFR-3) signaling system plays important roles in the process of lymphatic metastasis of tumors. In this article, we have reviewed the recent advances in research on the roles and mechanisms of VEGF-C/VEGF-D/VEGFR-3 signaling system in lymphatic metastasis of tumors.

articleTitle: Effect of antioxidant capacity on rat heart and serum by excessive intake of Vitamin A and zinc
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Vitamin A and zinc are essential nutrients. In order to study the effect of antioxidant capacity on on rat heart and serum by excessive intake of them and provide the experimental reference for the formulation of nutritional supplements about Vitamin A and zinc, 64 rats were randomly divided into four groups, namely, VA group, zinc group, combining VA and Zn group and control group. The antioxidant indicators of T-AOC, SOD, MDA and GSH-Px on rat heart and serum were determined after exposure 4 weeks, at the same time the blood components, including hemoglobin, platelet levels, cholesterol, triglycerides were also determined. The experimental data was analyzed with SPSS 15.0 statistical software. The results that there was obviously significantly difference on T-AOC, SOD, MDA and GSH-Px of heart and serum between all exposure groups and the control group. The blood components such as hemoglobin, red blood cell, platelet levels, cholesterol, triglycerides of rats between the various groups. Excessive intake of Vitamin A and Zinc can reduce antioxidant capacity of heart and serum in rats.

articleTitle: Intracranial arterial dolichoectasia involving both the vertebro-basilar and carotid systems: A case report
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Intracranial arterial dolichoectasia (IADE) is a cerebral vascular disease characterized by ectatic, extended and zigzag brain artery. It affects more frequently the posterior circulation system (vertebro-basilar system). Involvement of both the posterior and anterior circulation system (carotid systems) is rare. Here, we report a 71-year-old man who suffered from paroxysmal vertigo and diplopia. He was diagnosed as IADE by brain CT scan, MRI and CTA. This patient presented dolichoectasia involving both the basilar and carotid artery systems.

articleTitle: The relationship between arsenic exposure and skin lesions in endemic arsenicosis area of Shanxi Province, China
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Arsenic exposure from drinking water was considered to be a risk factor for skin lesions. In our research, the total arsenic in water and urine samples were analyzed by ICP-MS and AFS, respectively, Arsenic concentration in drinking water was 4.04-720μg/L, and there were 63.49% (80/126) samples above 50μg/L. Urinary total arsenic concentration was 6.51-775.73μg/gCr. Spearman rank correlation was used to analyze the strength of association between arsenic in drinking water and in urine(r=0.686, p<;0.05). The level of iron in drinking water was ranged from 0 to 6.46mg/L, and there were 18.4%(23/125) iron levels exceeding 0.5mg/L We observed the strong association between arsenic in drinking water and in urine, and dose-dependent increase in risk of skin lesions with increasing arsenic exposure. Especially, at lower levels of arsenic exposure(10-50μg/L), the effect of arsenic induced skin lesions was still observed. Iron and arsenic in the arsenic poisoning proceeding might exist combined effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of T cell receptor V beta diversity in peripheral CD8(+) T lymphocytes in patients with hepatitis B infection
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: A case-control study was carried out to explore the clonality of the T cell receptor Vbeta repertoires in complementarity determining region 3 in CD8(+) T lymphocyte of patients infected with HBV. The enrollment included 20 patients and 20 healthy donors. Multiple PCR amplification was applied to amplify many pieces of the T cell receptor Vbeta gene in complementarity determining region 3. High resolution agarose gel electrophoresis was employed to detect the clonality. By statistics, the percentage of monoclonal TCR Vbeta9 and Vbeta14 in CD8(+) T cell in patients' group were significantly higher than those in normal controls, 70.0 % vs 25.0 %, 85.0 % vs 30.0 % (p<; 0.01). The results showed that persons infected with HBV have the cloning changes of the T cell receptor Vbeta repertoire in CD8(+) T cell.

articleTitle: Research on the stickiness effects of ceramic brackets and light-cured composite resin prosthetic replacement treated with different adhesive agents and surface treatment
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To investigate the effects of different adhesive agents and surface treatments on the shear bonding strength of ceramic brackets to Light-cured composite resin Specimens. 60 resin specimens were divided randomly into three groups. Each group of 20 resin samples: The Jing-jin enamel adhesive (Group A), 3M ESPE adhesive (Group B), Bisco ortho-one orthodontic direct bonding system (Group C). Each group of 20 resin samples were divided randomly into two groups:10 samples with 9.6% hydrofluoric combined and other 10 samples with 9.6% hydrofluoric combined with silane. The shear bonding strength was measured and bond failure sites were classified according to Adhesive Remnant Index system, and recording the repair adhesive face rupture. The higher values were obtained with Bisco ortho-one orthodontic direct bonding system and 3M ESPE adhesive than Jing-jin enamel adhesive which can provide adequate shear bonding strength. But the Jing-jin enamel adhesive with 9.6% hydrofluoric cannot provide adequate shear bonding strength. After the adhesive agents are removed, the restoration burst rate of samples with 9.6% hydrofluoric combined with silane is higher than 9.6% hydrofluoric. The restoration burst rate of samples with 9.6% hydrofluoric combined with silane is higher. The Jing-jin enamel adhesive with 9.6% hydrofluoric cannot provide adequate shear bonding strength.

articleTitle: Identification and characterization of DNA fingerprint among Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don and other species of Fritillarias
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Objective: To explore the characterization of DNA fingerprints among Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don and other species, and to establish effective method to identify Fritillari cirrhosa D. Don from other species. Methods: Genomic DNAs were extracted from Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don and other species by the phenol method respectively. The specific primers for Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don were designed by Primer Primer 5.0 according to the 5srDNA sequence in GenBank (Acession No. AF 2303201.1), and PCR technique (Polymerase Chain Reaction) was carried out to amplify the amplicon from the Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don and others species. Results: The complete 19.3 kb DNA fragments were obtained from the Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don, F. prezwalskii Maxim, F. unibracteata Hsiao et K.C. Hsia. Only fragment with 274 bp was amplified from the Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don. Conclusion: The DNA fingerprint of Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don showed the specific characteristics, which could be used to identify Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don from others species. The method is an effective, simple, rapid and reliable in identifying the Fritillaria cirrhosa D. Don from others species.

articleTitle: Research on the psychological health status of firemen
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The research is conducted on the seniors of a fire academy as well as soldiers and officials of a fire brigade, 200 in total by means of group spot check. The Symptom Checklist90 (SCL-90) is adopted in the test. The writer analyzes the results of a spot check on firemen through questionnaire so as to provide basis for the psychological consultation and persuasion of fire brigade and guideline for the psychological training of firemen.

articleTitle: Food handling practices and food safety risks in the Chinese rural households
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: In household environment, pathogens have chances to move from raw meat to human body through improper meat handling practices, such as cross-contamination, improper storage and thawing, incorrect cooking temperature and time, and inappropriate treatment of leftover meat. The research surveyed 1200 rural households from China's 15 provinces and reavealed that there were serious food safety risks involved in food handling practices in rural households. Therefore it is critical that food safety intervention are targeted to rural consumers.

articleTitle: Situation analysis of metabolic syndrome and control strategies among staffs in university
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Metabolic Syndrome is increasing mortality from Cardio Vascular Disease and all-causes in the general population. The staffs in university is a kind of special occupational group whose work is primarily mental work. We analysed the physical examination data of 544 university staffs in Jilin province in 2010, the incidence of metabolic syndrome among university staffs was 10.29%. We suggested the relevant intervention strategies were changing lifestyle, taking regular physical exercise, providing psychologic services, establishing health early warning systems and early intervention and teatment.

articleTitle: Alcoholism and traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage: Further study on changes of TXA-2 / TXA2R and death mechanisms
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage (TSAH) related to alcoholism is a notable risk factor. Thromboxane A-2 (TXA-2) and its receptors-thromboxane A-2 receptor (TXA2R) of rat models were detected to further explore the death mechanisms. Seventy male Sprague-Dawley rats were divided into acute alcoholic intoxication and chronic alcoholism groups. Rat models had been established as previously study described. Compared with acute alcoholic rats, the chronic alcoholic rats showed significant changes: 1) higher morbidity and mortality from TSAH; 2) abnormal changes of ECG; 3) higher concentration of TXA-2 in plasma; 4) Over expression of TXA2R in brain tissue. It can be concluded that chronic alcoholism could cause increasing contents of TXA-2 in blood and expression of TXA2R in brain. After TSAH, they combine quickly in brain tissues, and excite vagal activity and inhibit cardiac function. The brain-heart connection may be one of the important mechanisms for the chronic alcoholism death from TSAH.

articleTitle: Systemic pelvic and paraaortic lymphadenectomy and prognostic significance in advanced epithelial ovarian malignancies: A meta-analysis and research
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: We designed to evaluate the influence of pelvic and paraaortic lymphadenectomy in the prognosis of advanced epithelial ovarian cancers. The test group was treated with lymphadenectomy after cytoreductive surgery and the control group was treated only with cytoreductive surgery. The 3-year overall survival (OS), 5-year OS, and incidence of perioperative complications were considered as index. A total of 5 studies involving 899 patients met the inclusion criteria. Comparison revealed the following: there was no significant difference for the 3-year OS (RR = 1.06, 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.94~1.20, P = 0.35) and 5-year OS (RR = 1.17, 95%CI: 0.98~1.39, P = 0.08); incidence of perioperative complications of the test group was significantly higher (RR = 1.58, 95%CI: 1.15~2.18, P = 0.005) than that of control group. In conclusion, pelvic and paraaortic lymphadenectomy after cytoreductive surgery cannot significantly improve the patient survival, but can significantly increase the incidence of perioperative complications.

articleTitle: Effect of Xylo-oligosaccharide and Fructo-oligosaccharide on the growth of selected probiotics in goat milk
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Different concentration oligosaccharide was added in goat milk. Effect of Xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS) and Fructo-oligosaccharide (FOS) on growth of Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium longum and L. rhamnosus was studied. The addition of each substance (w/v) was 0.0%, 0.1%, 0.5%, 1.0% 1.5% and 2.0%The methods were analyzed titratable acidity (°T), pH and enumeration that using reconstituted skim milk media as the control. All samples were incubated at 37 □ for 18h. The addition of each substance (w/v) was 0.0%, 0.1%, 0.5%, 1.0% 1.5% and 2.0%Results were as follows: addition of XOS has the significant increased effect on growth of B. longum and L. rhamnosus and a certain inhibition for L. acidophilus. FOS has significant promotion effect on the growth of B. longum, but not obvious for L. acidophilus and L. rhamnosus. So, XOS and FOS can be added as beneficial factor of probiotics in goat milk.

articleTitle: Influence of MTHFR 1298A→C polymorphism on response to transarterial chemoembolization in primary hepatocellular carcinoma: A pilot study
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To evaluate the influence of methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) 1298 A→Cpolymorphisms on response to transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) treatment for primary hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). 125 patients with HCC were treated with TACE alone. Of them, 63 patients underwent TACE using lipiodol mixed with cisplatin(DDP), Pirarubicin(THP) and mitomycin(MMC), and 62 patients underwent TACE using lipiodol mixed DDP, THP and 5-fluorouracil(5-Fu). In the TACE combined with DDP, THP and MMC group, the response rate of TACE were higher in patients carrying MTHFR 1298AA genotype than the subjects with the MTHFR 1298 AC genotype, but not in the TACE combined with DDP, THP and 5-Fu group. Our results suggest that MTHFR 1298 A→C polymorphism could influence response to TACE treatment using lipiodol mixed DDP, THP and MMC in HCC. Further studies with larger sample sizes are required to validate this association.

articleTitle: A study on the strategy and current development situation of the college girls' fitness and health in the Chinese universities
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: This study is based on the tests of the fitness and health of Year 2007 college girls in Jinggangshan University, located in the center of Jiangxi Province. The tests were performed in 2007 and 2010 twice. The result shows that the BMI and strength (grip strength) for the girl students has improved significantly (P<;0.01), while the athletic performance (standing long jump) and the cardiopulmonary function has worsen (P<;0.05) after four-year college life in 2010. From the test results, the overall quality of college girls' fitness has the downward trend and this should be paid close attention.

articleTitle: The prevalence and characterization of ESBLs producing isolates of klebsiella pneumoniae in some major hospitals, Jilin region
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: This study was carried out to investigate the antibiotic resistance and molecular epidemiology of K. pneumoniae producing ESBLs in some major hospitals in Jilin regions. K. pneumonaie isolates were examined for susceptibility to antimicrobial agents. ESBLs were detected by screening and confirming method, PCR, sequncing and conjuation assay. A total of 259 of K. pneumoniae were isolated from three affilated hospitals and one hundred and seventy-nine strains (69.2%) produced ESBLs, the number of eighty strains (30.8%) didn't produce ESBLs. Among K. pneumoniae producing ESBLs, 37 strains were positive for bla<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SHV-2</inf> gene, 44 strains contained bla<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TEM-2</inf> gene, and 22 strains had bla<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CTX-M-1</inf> gene, 21 strains contained bla<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CTX-M-2</inf> gene, 19 strains contained bla<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CTX-M-3</inf> and bla<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CTX-M-8</inf> gene respectively, 17 strains contained bla<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CTX-M-9</inf> gene. Imipenem was found as an effectiveness antibiotic against K. pneumoniae isolates. The data indicated a high prevalance of ESBL among K. pneumoniae in this region and their enzyme types were diverse.

articleTitle: Application of the new evaluation methods in cancer diagnosis based on serum tumor markers data
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To set up a new evalution method in diagnosis of different carcinomas through positive index (PI), sum of direct positive index (SDPI) and sum of indirect positive index (SIPI). PI was defined as a ratio of resulting value (RV) to reference value (RF) in the article. Statistics was carried out to calculated test results of serum tumor markers. With its difference from sensitivity, specificity and accuracy, the three indexes represented different tumors and related diseases. For those diseases which could not be differentiated by positive rates, the SDPI and SIPI would be used to distinguish a varieties of diseases with similar symptoms and provide better references in diagnosis of different carcinomas clinically.

articleTitle: Health education about hypertension in the elderly in rural Chinese villages
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: This study sought to examine baseline knowledge of hypertension among the elderly in rural western Chinese villages and to evaluate whether educational programs could improve their knowledge towards better hypertension prevention and management. We conducted a 25-day health education about hypertension, including health lectures, personal consultation and distribution of health pamphlets, etc., for 1182 randomly assigned elderly people in Shaanxi Province, P. R. China, during the period from June to September, 2007. All subjects received a questionnaire-based survey and then a 25-day health education on hypertension. Poor knowledge regarding the causes and preventive measures of hypertension was observed in these aged participants before implementation of the health education. However, their overall knowledge of hypertension was significantly improved after the health education (P<;0.05). Health education can greatly improve knowledge of hypertension, which may help to reduce the risk of hypertension in the elderly.

articleTitle: Identification on cytochrome b of Testudinis Carapax et Plastrum and its adulterants
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Objective: To establish a practical, accurate and convenient DNA molecular genetic marker technique for the identification of Testudinis Carapax et Plastrum. Methods: The mtDNA were extracted from Testudinis Carapax et Plastrum and its adulterants by salting-out method respectively. Bioinformatics technology was used to explore the identification and characterization of mitochondrial cytobchrome b gene from Chinemys revisii and other turtle species. A pair of allele-specific PCR primers were designed according to the cyt b gene, the PCR amplification were performed with mtDNA extracted from Testudinis Carapax et Plastrum and its adulterants. Results: The pure and intact mtDNA was extracted from Testudinis Carapax et Plastrum and its adulterants. The pair of allele-specific primers could only amplify the cyt b gene of Chinemys revisii with amplification of 319 bp. Conclusion: The primers are specific to Chinemys revisii mtDNA and could be used to discern Testudinis carapax et Plastrum from its adulterants.

articleTitle: Expression of PDGFR-β in colorectal cancer stroma and the relationship to lymphangiogenesis
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Objective : To test the expression of PDGFR-β in colorectal cancer stroma, and evaluate the relationship to lymphangiogenesis. Methods: Applying Immunohistochemistry SP method, the expression of PDGFR-β in 90 patients with colorectal cancer and 20 normal tissues. Marked by D2-40, lymphatic microvessel density (LMVD) was counted. The expression of PDGFR-β and its relationship to LMVD and clinicopathologic factors was analyzed. Results: The expression of PDGFR-β was found significantly higher in colorectal cancer stroma than in normal tissues surrounding tumors[PDGFR-β: 46.67%(42/90) vs 20%(4/20), P<;0.05]. The LMVD in cancer tissues was found significantly higher than in normal tissues surrounding tumors (P <;0.05). Higher LMVD was found in groups with lymph node metastasis (26.06 + 16.41 vs 17.26 + 12.97, t =2.582, P <;0.05). Also higher LMVD was found in colorectal cancer with positive PDGFR-β expression than with that corresponding negative expression [(27.63 + 15.46)vs (17.47 + 14.68), t =3.01, P <;0.05]. High PDGFR-β expression was significantly more common with lymph node metastasis (P<;0.05). Conclusion: The expression of PDGFR-β in colorectal cancer stroma was closely correlated with lymphangiogenesis and lymph node metastasis.

articleTitle: ER-a36 participate growth inhibiting which induced by Tamoxifen in gastric cancer cell line BGC823
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: We aimed to investigate the expression and location change of ER-a36 in BGC823 when dealt with TAM. Cell growth was examined by WST-1 and assayed by microplate reader. ER-a36 expressions in mRNA and protein were assayed by RT-PCR and Western-blot method and were quantitated. The location of ER-α36 in cell was examined by immunofluorenscence methods. The cell numbers significant decreased at all TAM treatment groups compared with control group and cell growth rate had a concentration-dependent of TAM. ER-α36 mRNA and protein expressions decreased at all TAM treatment groups compared with control group and had a concentration-dependent of TAM. ER-α36 is localized on the membrane and cytoplasm of BGC823 cell, and its location did not change when dealt with TAM TAM could inhibit the growth of BGC823 cell, and ER-α36 may transmit growth regulated signal of TAM through a membrane-based pathway in gastric cancer.

articleTitle: Biocompatibility and heat source evaluation on goose-head nail steel plates after radiation sterilization
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The aim of this study was to detect biocompatibility and heat source of goose-head nail steel plates sterilization by radiation, so as to evaluate the safety of radiation as a method of sterilization of medical devices. We set radiation sterilization dose and combined sensitization test, intracutaneous irritation tests, chromosome aberration test, Ames test and a local reaction test after implantation to evaluate the biocompatibility of radiation sterilized goose-head nail steel plates, we also conducted a heat source test to check whether the sterilized samples still have any heat source. The results suggest that the test samples have no sensitization, no intracutaneous irritation, no genotoxicity in chromosome aberration test and Ames test, and no heat source was found. Radiation sterilization is a biologically safe method for sterilization of medical devices.

articleTitle: Studies on the effects of corn polysaccharide and silkworm pupa to diabetes rats for decreasing blood glucose
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Objective: To explore the effects of decreasing blood glucose of extracts of corn and the pupa to diabetic rats induced by STZ. Method: The mixture of corn and the pupa is extracted by water lifting reduction. ICR rats were intraperitoneally injected of STZ 40 mg/Kg, animal model of diabetes was prepared; to observe fasting blood glucose levels (FBG) of mice with glucose oxidase; to observe the serum cholesterol (TC), triglyceride (TG), high density lipoprotein (HDL) and low-density lipoprotein (LDL) levels of all the animals with automatic biochemical analyzer; to observe serum insulin (INS) levels of mice with radioimmunoassay; Results: 1. Multiple low dose Intraperitoneal injection of STZ can lead to the model of diabetic mice close to the features of human disease. After modeling, diabetic mice have appeared typical symptoms of diabetes.2. Corn polysaccharide can alleviate the typical symptoms of diabetic mice, reduce blood sugar, improve lipid metabolism, advance insulin secrete of diabetic mice.

articleTitle: RAD001 (everolimus) induces antiproliferative effect and abnormal cell morphology in goat fetal fibroblasts under optical microscope
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) is an important controller of cell proliferation. RAD001 (everolimus) is a specific inhibitor of mTOR, can block mTOR signaling pathway. The purposes of this study are to explore the inhibitory effects of RAD001 on Cashmere goat fetal fibroblasts (GFb cells) proliferation. We examined both the effects of RAD001 on cell proliferation and cell shape of GFb cells. The GFb cells were treated with different concentrations of RAD001 (0.037 μM to 20.0μM) for 48h, and then the cell shape and proliferative density were observed with optical microscopy cell imaging. The results showed that GFb cells were sensitive to RAD001. RAD001 inhibits the cell proliferation. The morphological results indicated that mTOR is functional in GFb cells and acts as a key kinase to regulate cell proliferation. The synthesis of microfilament or organization of cytoskeleton perhaps was disrupted in GFb cells when mTOR was inhibited.

articleTitle: Change of amino acid network on the unfolding pathway
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Based on a modified amino acid network model, the dynamic simulation trajectory of a small protein (3CI2) is analyzed. The ration between different type of links is calculated, and the change of the long-rang link is calculated at the same time. With the conformation cluster analysis, the transition state can be got, and the network parameter betweenness of this state is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on development of the integrative management system of physical education and hygiene work in the high school
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve scientific, systematic, and computer network management of physical education, ADO technology is used to design a integrative management system of physical education and hygiene work in the school. This system can not only be used in integrated management of health, but also can be added new function based on the actual management needs. The system is programmed with ADO (ActiveX Data Objects) technology, and maintains the consistency of the code. This method can keep the user interface of system friendly, and can achieve the system's function well. Physical education and hygiene management will be more scientific, more modern and work efficiency will be more efficient through the sharing of resources, data general, network transmission of integrated management system in the school.

articleTitle: Investigation on CTX-M-type extended-spectrum (β-lactamase of Klebsiella pneumonia in Jilin Urban Area
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: To investigate the subtype of CTX-M-type extended-spectrum β-lactamase encoding gene and to research the resistance of Klebsiella pneumonia in Jilin Urban Area, and analysis the epidemiological aspect of CTX-M-producing isolates. PCR was used to detect CTX-M encoding gene in 118 strains of Klebsiella pneumoniae. Disc diffusion method was used to determine 14 kinds of antibiotics resistance for positive isolates. Arbitrarily primed polymerase chain reaction (AP-PCR) technique was used to type CTX-M producing isolates, and the fingerprinting profiles were produced according to the number and size of DNA bands. PCR amplification of 118 strains, 25 strains with CTX-M genotypes, account for 21.19%; which CTX-M-1 of 13 (11.02%); CTX-M-9 of 16 (13.56%); both with CTX-M-1 and CTX-M-9 of 4 strains (3.39%); CTX-M-2, CTX-M-8 and the CTX-M-25 were negative. 25 CTX-M positive strains were multidrug resistant (≥=53 antibiotics). The highest serviceability ratio of bacteria is in turn erythromycin (100%), cefotaxime (92%), ampicillin (92%), tetracyclin (88%). The lower rate of imipenem (4%) was susceptible to meropenem. There were 13 RAPD types in 26 isolates of 25 strains of CTX-M positive bacteria. CTX-M type extended spectrum β-lactamases of Klebsiella pneumoniae as multiple drug-resistant bacteria, CTX-M enzymes are certainly colony spreading.

articleTitle: Primary culture of rabbit retinal Müller cells in vitro and the identification
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Rabbit retinal Müller cells were cultured in vitro with suspended constitution. Electron microscopy and immunocytochemical method were used to evaluate cells. The cells attached to the wall of culture dishes while growing and showed large, flattened shape. Characteristic intermediate filament (8~10 nm) could be seen in the cytoplasm by transmission electron microscopy. The cultured cells showed positive reaction for glial fibriliary acid protein (GFAP) and S-100, and negative reaction for factor VIII related antigen with an immunocytochemical assay. The tissue suspending method is a stable and reliable method to obtain rabbit retinal Müller cells.

articleTitle: Investigation on PE value orientation of domestic undergraduates
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Adopting documentation and questionnaire method, the thesis investigates the PE value orientation of domestic undergraduates in the background of social transition, harmonious society construction and the new trend of PE development. Research finds that PE value orientation of domestic undergraduates during the new period are shown as follows: Firstly, the diversification of PE value orientation of domestic undergraduates has been formed during the new period. Secondly, Individual-oriented PE value orientation is increasingly highlighted. Thirdly, Utilitarianistic PE value orientation still exists. Based on analyzing the PE value orientation of domestic undergraduates during the new period, the thesis will put forward pertinent suggestions.

articleTitle: Clinical analyses of neonatal sepsis caused by Listeria monocytogene
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Sepsis is one of the most common disease of mortality during neonatal period, especially infected by Listeria monocytogene (LM). If organisms were acquired in uterus, sepsis can lead to serious septicemia with a higher mortality than acquired after birth. Clinical datas were collected in 9 cases who suffered from sepsis caused by LM Following characteristics of the LM infection were summarized. such as: Pregnancy history: Mother has symptom of infection such as chills, fever. Turbid amniotic fluid and fetal distress in uterus, the neonates have fever, dyspnea, rash, hepatosplenomegaly, seizure, Most cases white blood cell count is elevated, but in cases where white blood cell count is below 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>/L always indicated serious infection. Blood culture and CSF test should be done as routine test, correct medicine should be choose by Neonatologists in order to found the neonates accorded with meningitis.

articleTitle: pLXSN-Tum-5 inducing HUVEC apoptosis through mitochondrial pathway
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: Formation of vessels is a key regulator for the growth of solid tumor. So, angiogenesis inhibitors are very important for the cancer therapy. Tumstatin is a 28 kDa cryptic domain shed from the carboxy terminal region of a3 chain type IV collagen by matrix metalloproteases. Tumstatin can inhibit tumor growth in mice by inducing the apoptosis in endothelial cells. But, it is indefinite that whether Tum-5 can induce human endothelial cells apoptosis. Based on the isolation of the coding sequence of human Tum-5 and constructing it into plasmid pLXSN, We investigated the apoptosis induced by Tum-5 and the mechanism by the transfect of retroviral packing Tum-5 gene into cultured HUVEC. The results illuminated that Tum-5 significantly inhibited HUVEC cell proliferation in a titer dependent model, and Tum-5 can also induced human EC apoptosis. The translation and transcription of Bax were up-regulated Bcl-2 was down-regulated, and followed the rising of Bax/Bcl-2 ratio the caspase-3 over expression. In conclusion, Tum-5 may induce HUVEC apoptosis through a mitochondrial pathway.

articleTitle: Acute oral toxicity and Ames-mutagenicity of domestic waste decomposing microbial inoculants WU-1
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2011 International Conference on Human Health and Biomedical Engineering
abstract: The domestic waste decomposing microbial inoculants WU-1 was prepared in our lab and its acute oral toxicity and Ames-mutagenicity were determined.
